description: Test suite for role store functionalities in Mattermost, including CRUD operations, role retrieval by various criteria, and scoped permission checks within channel and team schemes.

methods.name: testRoleStoreSave
methods.description: Tests saving new roles, updating roles, and error conditions for invalid or duplicate roles.

methods.name: testRoleStoreGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all roles, including after adding new roles.

methods.name: testRoleStoreGet
methods.description: Tests retrieving roles by ID, including error handling for non-existent roles.

methods.name: testRoleStoreGetByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving roles by name, including error handling for non-existent roles.

methods.name: testRoleStoreGetByNames
methods.description: Tests batch retrieval of roles by multiple names, including partial matches and empty results.

methods.name: testRoleStoreDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting roles and verifying soft deletion via 'DeleteAt' field, including error handling for non-existent roles.

methods.name: testRoleStorePermanentDeleteAll
methods.description: Tests permanent deletion of all roles and verifying they are removed.

methods.name: testRoleStoreLowerScopedChannelSchemeRoles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of roles scoped to channels within specific schemes, ensuring correct association with scheme IDs.

methods.name: testRoleStoreChannelHigherScopedPermissionsBlankTeamSchemeChannelGuest
methods.description: Tests permission inheritance and handling of blank default roles in schemes, ensuring permissions are correctly inherited and cache is refreshed.
